releaseNotes:
• Fixed double SUBTOTAL on Incotex receipts (root cause: AMEF ignores print=0 flag on CMD 51)
• Incotex: CMD 51 (Subtotal) is now only sent when a discount/markup exists; total calculated locally for plain receipts
• Auto Detect overhaul for Datecs, Incotex and Daisy using ISL protocol serial number validation
• Incotex: improved subtotal logic — device auto-prints SUBTOTAL during payment, no duplicate
